name: How do you build a custom home on a narrow lot in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How do you build a custom home on a narrow lot in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: How do you build a custom home on a narrow lot in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a custom home on a narrow lot in Los Angeles requires more than a good floor plan. The team must plan for construction access, material staging, parking, crane or pump access if needed, neighbor protection, and how crews will move through the site safely. The design must also work with setbacks, privacy, natural light, ventilation, and code requirements. Narrow lots can make foundation work, framing, and utility installation more complicated, which affects both cost and schedule. Homeowners should ask the builder whether the site can realistically support the chosen design and whether any wall-sharing, easement, or access constraints exist. In dense neighborhoods, protecting adjacent properties and maintaining good neighbor relations can matter as much as the house itself. A good builder will treat the lot as a logistical puzzle, not just a footprint. The earlier the team studies the site, the easier it is to avoid costly redesigns.
